    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(input[0])
    h = list(map(int, input[1:]))

    stack = []
    for i in range(n):
        while stack and h[stack[-1]] + 2 <= h[i]:
            j = stack.pop()
            diff = min(h[j] + 2, h[i]) - h[j]
            h[j] += diff
            h[i] -= diff
        if stack:
            diff = min(h[stack[-1]], h[i] + 2) - h[i]
            h[stack[-1]] -= diff
            h[i] += diff
        stack.append(i)

    print(' '.join(map(str, h)))
